judged_text: The spec only stubs site settings and asserts the guard clause; the actual parse/import loop — the link/id fallback, CGI.unescapeHTML, and the TopicEmbed.import call — executes in no test in the diff. A regression in item handling (e.g., the i.content/i.link field mapping breaking on feeds without content:encoded) silently disables every feed import — the job runs hourly with retry: false and no spec fails, surfacing only as mysteriously empty embedded topics in production.
